text: ＊は　いちゃもんを　つけられたので　つづけて　おなじ　わざが　だせない！

structure.jp: いちゃもんを　つけられたので
つづけて　おなじ　わざが　だせない！
structure.en: it can't use the same move twice in a row!

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: られる on a verb here says the action was done to someone. いちゃもんを　つけられた = 'had Torment used on it'.

patterns.name: 〜ので
patterns.explanation: ので after a statement gives the reason for what comes next. つけられたので = 'because it had that done to it'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing だす to だせる means 'can put out', and ない makes it 'cannot'. わざが　だせない = 'can't use the move'.
